dessin: A fragment of a town map seen from above, drawn only with thin grey lines #7D8576 on the background color, inside a thin grey rectangular frame: an orthogonal grid of city blocks, all streets strictly horizontal or strictly vertical (no tilt, no diagonal), streets drawn as pale gaps between two parallel thin lines. The central block is larger than the others, an axis-aligned rectangle about 40% of the map width and half of its height, and completely empty. Smaller blocks around it are cut by the frame. No buildings anywhere, no trees, no water, no symbols, no fills. Nothing else.
